4759.title: Terminal input translation loses macOS Command editing
4759.rootCauseOneLine: The terminal has no macOS editing override: xterm emits no input for Command arrows and DEL for Command Backspace; BB forwards those bytes without translating them.

prReviews.verdict: ROOT CAUSE ADDRESSED — static review only
prReviews.topFinding: The diff installs a macOS-scoped xterm key handler and routes mapped input through onData. Its branch was not run. Option arrows already move words in the tested Bash defaults; native macOS and terminal integration remain unverified.

4759.proposedFix: Provide macOS-only Command editing translation at the xterm input boundary, preserve other modifiers/platforms, and verify terminal-to-transport input plus native macOS behavior. Existing open PR 4760 already targets this boundary; no duplicate fix PR is opened.
4759.caveats: Command editing failures repeated using each clean checkout's pinned xterm bundle, simulated MacIntel keyboard events, and real Bash Readline. This is not a native macOS desktop test or a mounted BB component. Option arrow sequences differ from ESC b/f but already perform word movement in Bash 5.2.15. zsh was unavailable.
